posts.title: A Better Way to Load Your Shokz
posts.description: Loading music onto Shokz OpenSwim headphones means dragging MP3s onto a USB drive in Finder. Conduxor is a Mac app that browses your Apple Music library, copies tracks to your headphones, and tracks what's already on the device.

posts.title: Building Chewie Mode with Claude
posts.description: A look at how I modified the Ghost Solo theme with Claude Code to build Chewie Mode, a poster style layout inspired by early hip hop flyers.
